description: After a run completes or fails, optionally send a push notification to the operator. Configurable in otto.yaml under a new `notifications` block. Support at least one backend on launch: ntfy (self-hosted or ntfy.sh) via a simple POST with the run summary and outcome. The config should specify a URL and optional topic/token. Notification is fire-and-forget with a short timeout (5s) — failure to notify must never block or fail the run. Include success and failure message templates that include the repo, issue/PR number, and branch or error reason.
title: Configurable push notifications on run completion and failure
